Description: Enable student teams to create, edit and submit project profiles with verified repository URLs.
Allow panel judges to evaluate student projects using a digital rubric and view results.
Allow public visitors to browse and vote for projects securely without bot interference.
Compute and display real-time leaderboards based on votes and judge scores.
As a student team, I want to create a new showcase project profile, so that I can submit our project for the expo.
As a student team, I want to link our GitHub repository, so that judges and visitors can verify our code.
As a student team, I want to embed a demo video link, so that our presentation is visible to voters.
As a system, I want to validate repository URLs upon submission, so that only valid and accessible repositories are saved.
As a panel judge, I want to view my assigned student projects, so that I know what to evaluate.
As a panel judge, I want to submit scores using a multi-criteria digital rubric, so that evaluations are standardized.
As a panel judge, I want to provide qualitative feedback with my scores, so that students can learn from my assessment.
As a student team, I want to view the evaluation analytics and judge feedback post-expo, so that we can improve.
As a public visitor, I want to browse eligible showcase projects, so that I can decide who to vote for.
As a public visitor, I want to cast a vote for my favorite project, so that they can win the public choice award.
As an anti-sybil service, I want to run automated checks (device fingerprinting, IP limits, CAPTCHA) on each vote, so that bots and duplicate votes are blocked.
As a system, I want to encrypt voter credentials in transit and at rest, so that voter data is secure.
As a system, I want to calculate real-time dynamic leaderboards based on votes and judge scores, so that standings are live.
As an expo attendee, I want to view the real-time leaderboard with sub-300ms latency, so that I can follow the competition without lag.
